1	"""Node state transitions: the protocol core of the simulation.
2	
3	The :class:`_Protocol` mixin holds every transition a node can go through —
4	elections and the optional pre-vote phase, log replication and compaction,
5	joint-consensus membership changes, read-only queries, client commands, the
6	crash/restart lifecycle and liveness evaluation — plus the handlers for
7	every message kind the network can deliver.
8	
9	The composing simulator provides the shared run-time state: ``state`` (node
10	name -> ``_Node``), ``queue`` (``EventQueue``), ``network`` (``Network``),
11	the timeline recorder ``_record`` and the bookkeeping dictionaries. Every
12	method here only mutates that state, in the established deterministic order.
13	"""
14	
15	from __future__ import annotations
16	
17	from .events import _KIND_HEARTBEAT, _KIND_TIMEOUT
18	from .node import (
19	    CONFIG_JOINT,
20	    CONFIG_STABLE,
21	    KIND_COMMAND,
22	    KIND_CONFIG,
23	    ROLE_CANDIDATE,
24	    ROLE_FOLLOWER,
25	    ROLE_LEADER,
26	    ROLE_PRECANDIDATE,
27	    _Node,
28	)
29	
30	
31	class _Protocol:
32	    # -- timeline helpers -------------------------------------------------
33	
34	    def _record(self, entry: dict) -> None:
35	        self.timeline.append({"seq": len(self.timeline) + 1, "time": self.now, **entry})
36	
37	    def _record_state_change(self, name: str, reason: str) -> None:
38	        st = self.state[name]
39	        self._record({"type": "stateChange", "node": name, "term": st.term, "role": st.role, "reason": reason})
40	
41	    # -- configuration -------------------------------------------------------
42	
43	    def _command_entry(self, index: int, term: int, command_id: str, command: object) -> dict:
44	        """A client-command log/applied entry. When membership changes are
45	        enabled it carries ``kind: "command"`` so configuration entries
46	        (``kind: "config"``) are unambiguously distinguishable; without the
47	        feature the historical, untyped shape is preserved byte for byte."""
48	        entry = {"index": index, "term": term}
49	        if self.membership_enabled:
50	            entry["kind"] = KIND_COMMAND
51	        entry["id"] = command_id
52	        entry["command"] = command
53	        return entry
54	
55	    @staticmethod
56	    def _config_groups(config: dict) -> tuple[frozenset[str], frozenset[str]]:
57	        """The (old, new) voter sets of a configuration. Stable configurations
58	        carry the same set twice; joint configurations carry both."""
59	        return frozenset(config["old"]), frozenset(config["new"])
60	
61	    def _config_quorums(self, config: dict) -> list[frozenset[str]]:
62	        old, new = self._config_groups(config)
63	        if config.get("type") == CONFIG_JOINT:
64	            return [old, new]
65	        return [new]
66	
67	    def _is_voter(self, name: str, config: dict) -> bool:
68	        old, new = self._config_groups(config)
69	        return name in old or name in new
70	
71	    def _can_vote(self, name: str) -> bool:
72	        """Current voting/election eligibility from the node's newest
73	        configuration: learners and nodes not present in the latest config
74	        neither vote nor campaign. A removed node that learns a configuration
75	        adding it back regains eligibility."""
76	        st = self.state[name]
77	        return self._is_voter(name, st.latest_config(self.initial_config))
78	
79	    @staticmethod
80	    def _store_config(config: dict) -> dict:
81	        old, new = _Protocol._config_groups(config)
82	        return {
83	            "type": config.get("type", CONFIG_STABLE),
84	            "old": sorted(old),
85	            "new": sorted(new),
86	        }
87	
88	    def _joint_config(self, voters: frozenset[str], action: str, member: str) -> dict:
89	        if action == "add":
90	            new_voters = voters | {member}
91	        else:
92	            new_voters = voters - {member}
93	        return {"type": CONFIG_JOINT, "old": sorted(voters), "new": sorted(new_voters)}
94	
95	    @staticmethod
96	    def _stable_config(voters: frozenset[str]) -> dict:
97	        ordered = sorted(voters)
98	        return {"type": CONFIG_STABLE, "old": ordered, "new": ordered}
99	
100	    def _has_vote_majorities(self, candidate: str, votes: set[str], config: dict) -> bool:
101	        for group in self._config_quorums(config):
102	            needed = len(group) // 2 + 1
103	            if len([v for v in votes if v in group]) < needed:
104	                return False
105	        return True
106	
107	    def _replicated_by_majorities(self, leader: str, index: int, config: dict) -> bool:
108	        """Whether ``index`` is present on a strict majority of every quorum
109	        group (the leader itself counts in any group it belongs to)."""
110	        st = self.state[leader]
111	        for group in self._config_quorums(config):
112	            needed = len(group) // 2 + 1
113	            points = []
114	            for peer in group:
115	                if peer == leader:
116	                    points.append(st.last_log_index())
117	                else:
118	                    points.append(st.match_index.get(peer, 0))
119	            if len([point for point in points if point >= index]) < needed:
120	                return False
121	        return True
122	
123	    # -- state transitions --------------------------------------------------
124	
125	    def _invalidate_timeout(self, name: str) -> None:
126	        self.state[name].timeout_gen += 1
127	
128	    def _reset_timeout(self, name: str) -> None:
129	        st = self.state[name]
130	        if not self._can_vote(name):
131	            # Learners and removed members hold no election timer; bumping the
132	            # generation cancels any timer scheduled before their membership
133	            # changed.
134	            st.timeout_gen += 1
135	            return
136	        st.timeout_gen += 1
137	        self.queue.push(
138	            (self.now + self.timeouts[name], _KIND_TIMEOUT, self.index[name], (name, st.timeout_gen)),
139	        )
140	
141	    def _reconcile_election_timer(self, name: str, eligible_before: bool) -> None:
142	        """Start or cancel a node's election timer when its configuration
143	        membership changes (e.g. a learner promoted by a replicated joint
144	        entry, or a member removed by a replicated stable entry)."""
145	        eligible_after = self._can_vote(name)
146	        if eligible_after and not eligible_before:
147	            self._reset_timeout(name)
148	        elif eligible_before and not eligible_after:
149	            self._invalidate_timeout(name)
150	
151	    def _become_follower(self, name: str, term: int, reason: str) -> None:
152	        st = self.state[name]
153	        st.role = ROLE_FOLLOWER
154	        st.term = term
155	        st.voted_for = None
156	        st.known_leader = None
157	        st.votes = set()
158	        st.next_index = {}
159	        st.match_index = {}
160	        # The active round is abandoned; the round counter itself is a
161	        # lifetime-monotonic nonce so a reply in flight from a superseded
162	        # round (including one that straddles a restart) can never match a
163	        # later round.
164	        st.pre_term = 0
165	        st.pre_votes = set()
166	        st.pre_config = None
167	        # A new term means the previous term's leader contact no longer
168	        # counts; the heartbeat/appendEntries/installSnapshot handlers mark a
169	        # fresh contact immediately after stepping down on a leader message.
170	        st.leader_contact = -1
171	        self._reset_timeout(name)
172	        self._record_state_change(name, reason)
173	        # A deposed leader can no longer vouch for reads it accepted.
174	        self._abandon_reads(name)
175	
176	    def _start_election(self, name: str) -> None:
177	        st = self.state[name]
178	        # The election is decided under the configuration in place just
179	        # before the candidate appends anything (joint configs require
180	        # majorities of both constituent sets).
181	        config = st.latest_config(self.initial_config)
182	        st.role = ROLE_CANDIDATE
183	        st.term += 1
184	        st.voted_for = name
185	        st.known_leader = None
186	        st.votes = {name}
187	        st.next_index = {}
188	        st.match_index = {}
189	        # Winning election traffic is not leader contact: nothing has
190	        # contacted this node from the new term yet.
191	        st.leader_contact = -1
192	        self._reset_timeout(name)
193	        self._record_state_change(name, "electionTimeout")
194	        for peer in self.node_names:
195	            if peer != name and self._is_voter(peer, config):
196	                self.network.send(
197	                    name,
198	                    peer,
199	                    {
200	                        "kind": "requestVote",
201	                        "term": st.term,
202	                        "lastLogIndex": st.last_log_index(),
203	                        "lastLogTerm": st.last_log_term(),
204	                    },
205	                )
206	
207	    def _start_pre_vote(self, name: str) -> None:
208	        """Enter the pre-candidate phase for a new round. The current term,
209	        votedFor and the log are all left untouched; only a prospective term
210	        of term + 1 and a round number are attached to the probes."""
211	        st = self.state[name]
212	        config = st.latest_config(self.initial_config)
213	        st.role = ROLE_PRECANDIDATE
214	        st.pre_round += 1
215	        st.pre_term = st.term + 1
216	        st.pre_votes = {name}
217	        st.pre_config = config
218	        self._reset_timeout(name)
219	        self._record_state_change(name, "electionTimeout")
220	        for peer in self.node_names:
221	            if peer != name and self._is_voter(peer, config):
222	                self.network.send(
223	                    name,
224	                    peer,
225	                    {
226	                        "kind": "preVote",
227	                        "term": st.term,
228	                        "prospectiveTerm": st.pre_term,
229	                        "round": st.pre_round,
230	                        "lastLogIndex": st.last_log_index(),
231	                        "lastLogTerm": st.last_log_term(),
232	                    },
233	                )
234	
235	    def _promote_from_pre_vote(self, name: str) -> None:
236	        """A pre-vote round won the required majorities: now start the real
237	        election, raising the term to the prospective term and persisting the
238	        self-vote, and broadcast RequestVote in that term."""
239	        st = self.state[name]
240	        config = st.pre_config
241	        prospective = st.pre_term
242	        st.role = ROLE_CANDIDATE
243	        st.pre_term = 0
244	        st.pre_votes = set()
245	        st.pre_config = None
246	        st.term = prospective
247	        st.voted_for = name
248	        st.known_leader = None
249	        st.votes = {name}
250	        st.next_index = {}
251	        st.match_index = {}
252	        # Promotion is election traffic, not leader contact.
253	        st.leader_contact = -1
254	        self._reset_timeout(name)
255	        # The transition to a real candidate in the prospective term is the
256	        # only state event the promotion needs; RequestVote traffic follows.
257	        self._record_state_change(name, "preVoteMajority")
258	        for peer in self.node_names:
259	            if peer != name and self._is_voter(peer, config):
260	                self.network.send(
261	                    name,
262	                    peer,
263	                    {
264	                        "kind": "requestVote",
265	                        "term": st.term,
266	                        "lastLogIndex": st.last_log_index(),
267	                        "lastLogTerm": st.last_log_term(),
268	                    },
269	                )
270	
271	    def _become_leader(self, name: str, config: dict) -> None:
272	        st = self.state[name]
273	        st.role = ROLE_LEADER
274	        st.known_leader = name
275	        st.votes = set()
276	        st.pre_term = 0
277	        st.pre_votes = set()
278	        st.pre_config = None
279	        st.timeout_gen += 1  # leaders have no election timeout
280	        next_index = st.last_log_index() + 1
281	        # Replication progress is tracked for every other node: voters count
282	        # towards quorums, learners receive the log but never count.
283	        st.next_index = {peer: next_index for peer in self.node_names if peer != name}
284	        st.match_index = {peer: 0 for peer in self.node_names if peer != name}
285	        self._record_state_change(name, "majority")
286	        leaders = self.leaders_by_term.setdefault(st.term, [])
287	        if name not in leaders:
288	            leaders.append(name)
289	        self._send_heartbeats(name)
290	        self._resume_membership_change(name)

292	    def _resume_membership_change(self, name: str) -> None:
293	        """Finish a change a previous leader left open. If the newest config
294	        entry present is a joint entry (with no stable entry following it),
295	        append the stable entry now: winning this term's election required
296	        majorities of both joint sets, so the joint entry is known to be on
297	        those majorities even before commitIndex advanced to it."""
298	        st = self.state[name]
299	        if st.latest_config(self.initial_config).get("type") == CONFIG_JOINT:
300	            joint_entry = None
301	            # Newest joint entry in the uncompacted log, otherwise the newest
302	            # one folded into the snapshot's applied history.
303	            for log_entry in reversed(st.log):
304	                if log_entry.get("kind") == KIND_CONFIG and log_entry["entryType"] == CONFIG_JOINT:
305	                    joint_entry = log_entry
306	                    break
307	            if joint_entry is None:
308	                for applied in reversed(st.applied):
309	                    if (
310	                        applied.get("kind") == KIND_CONFIG
311	                        and applied["entryType"] == CONFIG_JOINT
312	                    ):
313	                        joint_entry = applied
314	                        break
315	            if joint_entry is not None:
316	                _old, new_voters = self._config_groups(joint_entry["config"])
317	                stable = self._stable_config(new_voters)
318	                self._append_config_entry(
319	                    name,
320	                    joint_entry["id"],
321	                    CONFIG_STABLE,
322	                    stable,
323	                    joint_entry["action"],
324	                    joint_entry["member"],
325	                )
326	                for peer in self.node_names:
327	                    if peer != name:
328	                        self._replicate_to(name, peer)
329	        if self.pending_catchup is not None:
330	            if self.pending_catchup["leader"] != name:
331	                # The old leader was replaced before it appended the joint
332	                # entry; the unfinished catch-up is abandoned.
333	                self.pending_catchup = None
334	            else:
335	                self._progress_catchup(name)

337	    # -- message dispatch -----------------------------------------------------
338	
339	    def _deliver(self, msg: dict) -> None:
340	        if not self.network.deliver(msg, self.state[msg["dst"]].online):
341	            return
342	        kind = msg["kind"]
343	        if kind == "requestVote":
344	            self._handle_request_vote(msg)
345	        elif kind == "voteReply":
346	            self._handle_vote_reply(msg)
347	        elif kind == "preVote":
348	            self._handle_pre_vote(msg)
349	        elif kind == "preVoteReply":
350	            self._handle_pre_vote_reply(msg)
351	        elif kind == "heartbeat":
352	            self._handle_heartbeat(msg)
353	        elif kind == "appendEntries":
354	            self._handle_append_entries(msg)
355	        elif kind == "installSnapshot":
356	            self._handle_install_snapshot(msg)
357	        elif kind == "installSnapshotReply":
358	            self._handle_snapshot_reply(msg)
359	        elif kind == "readProbe":
360	            self._handle_read_probe(msg)
361	        elif kind == "readReply":
362	            self._handle_read_reply(msg)
363	        else:
364	            self._handle_append_reply(msg)

366	    def _send_heartbeats(self, name: str) -> None:
367	        """Per peer, send either a log-carrying appendEntries (when the peer is
368	        behind) or a bare heartbeat (when its log already matches). Mixing the
369	        two would let an empty heartbeat's leaderCommit make a divergent peer
370	        apply entries that the appendEntries is about to overwrite. The
371	        appendEntries handler truncates, appends and advances the commit in one
372	        atomic step, so it alone is safe for a lagging peer."""
373	        st = self.state[name]
374	        for peer in self.node_names:
375	            if peer == name:
376	                continue
377	            if st.match_index[peer] < st.last_log_index():
378	                self._replicate_to(name, peer)
379	            else:
380	                self.network.send(
381	                    name,
382	                    peer,
383	                    {"kind": "heartbeat", "term": st.term, "leaderCommit": st.commit_index},
384	                )
385	        self.queue.push(
386	            (self.now + self.heartbeat_interval, _KIND_HEARTBEAT, self.index[name], (name, st.term)),
387	        )

389	    def _replicate_to(self, name: str, peer: str) -> None:
390	        """Send the next due message for one peer: an installSnapshot when the
391	        peer's next position is already covered by the leader's snapshot,
392	        otherwise an appendEntries carrying the uncompacted suffix slice."""
393	        st = self.state[name]
394	        next_idx = st.next_index[peer]
395	        if next_idx <= st.snapshot_index:
396	            # The snapshot bundles the applied state through lastIncludedIndex.
397	            snapshot_entries = [dict(entry) for entry in st.applied[: st.snapshot_index]]
398	            self.network.send(
399	                name,
400	                peer,
401	                {
402	                    "kind": "installSnapshot",
403	                    "term": st.term,
404	                    "lastIncludedIndex": st.snapshot_index,
405	                    "lastIncludedTerm": st.snapshot_term,
406	                    "entries": snapshot_entries,
407	                },
408	            )
409	            return
410	        prev_idx = next_idx - 1
411	        entries = [dict(entry) for entry in st.log[next_idx - 1 - st.snapshot_index:]]
412	        self.network.send(
413	            name,
414	            peer,
415	            {
416	                "kind": "appendEntries",
417	                "term": st.term,
418	                "prevLogIndex": prev_idx,
419	                "prevLogTerm": st.term_at(prev_idx),
420	                "entries": entries,
421	                "leaderCommit": st.commit_index,
422	            },
423	        )

425	    def _handle_request_vote(self, msg: dict) -> None:
426	        src, dst = msg["src"], msg["dst"]
427	        st = self.state[dst]
428	        # A higher term clears voted_for before the vote decision is made.
429	        effective_voted_for = None if msg["term"] > st.term else st.voted_for
430	        up_to_date = (
431	            msg["lastLogTerm"] > st.last_log_term()
432	            or (
433	                msg["lastLogTerm"] == st.last_log_term()
434	                and msg["lastLogIndex"] >= st.last_log_index()
435	            )
436	        )
437	        # Learners and removed members never grant a vote; candidates only
438	        # solicit voters, so stale RVs reaching a demoted node are denied.
439	        eligible_voter = self._can_vote(dst)
440	        granted = (
441	            eligible_voter
442	            and msg["term"] >= st.term
443	            and up_to_date
444	            and (effective_voted_for is None or effective_voted_for == src)
445	        )
446	        self._record({
447	            "type": "messageResult",
448	            "node": dst,
449	            "peer": src,
450	            "message": "requestVote",
451	            "term": msg["term"],
452	            "result": "delivered",
453	            "detail": "voteGranted" if granted else "voteDenied",
454	        })
455	        if msg["term"] > st.term:
456	            self._become_follower(dst, msg["term"], "higherTermMessage")
457	        if granted:
458	            st.voted_for = src
459	        self.network.send(dst, src, {"kind": "voteReply", "term": st.term, "granted": granted})

461	    def _handle_vote_reply(self, msg: dict) -> None:
462	        src, dst = msg["src"], msg["dst"]
463	        st = self.state[dst]
464	        detail = "ignored"
465	        elected = False
466	        election_config = st.latest_config(self.initial_config)
467	        if msg["term"] > st.term:
468	            detail = "higherTerm"
469	        elif st.role == ROLE_CANDIDATE and msg["term"] == st.term and msg["granted"]:
470	            st.votes.add(src)
471	            detail = "voteCounted"
472	            elected = self._has_vote_majorities(dst, st.votes, election_config)
473	        self._record({
474	            "type": "messageResult",
475	            "node": dst,
476	            "peer": src,
477	            "message": "voteReply",
478	            "term": msg["term"],
479	            "result": "delivered",
480	            "detail": detail,
481	        })
482	        if msg["term"] > st.term:
483	            self._become_follower(dst, msg["term"], "higherTermMessage")
484	        elif elected:
485	            self._become_leader(dst, election_config)

487	    # -- pre-vote (optional phase) ------------------------------------------
488	
489	    def _pre_vote_deadline_passed(self, name: str) -> bool:
490	        """Whether a current-term leader contact is old enough that the local
491	        election deadline has elapsed. No recorded contact (startup, restart
492	        or term entered through election traffic) always passes."""
493	        contact = self.state[name].leader_contact
494	        return contact < 0 or self.now >= contact + self.timeouts[name]

496	    def _handle_pre_vote(self, msg: dict) -> None:
497	        src, dst = msg["src"], msg["dst"]
498	        st = self.state[dst]
499	        up_to_date = (
500	            msg["lastLogTerm"] > st.last_log_term()
501	            or (
502	                msg["lastLogTerm"] == st.last_log_term()
503	                and msg["lastLogIndex"] >= st.last_log_index()
504	            )
505	        )
506	        # A pre-vote never changes the receiver's term, vote or timer; it is
507	        # granted solely on merit and on the absence of a recently heard
508	        # current-term leader. Learners and removed members have no vote, the
509	        # current leader never grants one, a stale prospective term is
510	        # refused, and a node that heard a viable leader within its election
511	        # deadline refuses so it cannot help a partitioned peer disrupt the
512	        # stable leader.
513	        granted = (
514	            self._can_vote(dst)
515	            and st.role != ROLE_LEADER
516	            and msg["prospectiveTerm"] >= st.term + 1
517	            and up_to_date
518	            and self._pre_vote_deadline_passed(dst)
519	        )
520	        self._record({
521	            "type": "messageResult",
522	            "node": dst,
523	            "peer": src,
524	            "message": "preVote",
525	            "term": msg["term"],
526	            "round": msg["round"],
527	            "prospectiveTerm": msg["prospectiveTerm"],
528	            "result": "delivered",
529	            "detail": "granted" if granted else "rejected",
530	        })
531	        # Reply with the receiver's *current* (unchanged) term so a
532	        # pre-candidate facing a higher real term learns it and stands down.
533	        self.network.send(
534	            dst,
535	            src,
536	            {
537	                "kind": "preVoteReply",
538	                "term": st.term,
539	                "prospectiveTerm": msg["prospectiveTerm"],
540	                "round": msg["round"],
541	                "granted": granted,
542	            },
543	        )
544	
545	    def _handle_pre_vote_reply(self, msg: dict) -> None:
546	        src, dst = msg["src"], msg["dst"]
547	        st = self.state[dst]
548	        detail = "staleRound"
549	        won = False
550	        if msg["term"] > st.term:
551	            # A reply carrying a higher real term ends the round outright.
552	            detail = "higherTerm"
553	        elif (
554	            st.role == ROLE_PRECANDIDATE
555	            and msg["round"] == st.pre_round
556	            and msg["prospectiveTerm"] == st.pre_term
557	        ):
558	            if msg["granted"]:
559	                st.pre_votes.add(src)
560	                detail = "granted"
561	                if self._can_vote(dst) and self._has_vote_majorities(
562	                    dst, st.pre_votes, st.pre_config
563	                ):
564	                    won = True
565	            else:
566	                detail = "rejected"
567	        self._record({
568	            "type": "messageResult",
569	            "node": dst,
570	            "peer": src,
571	            "message": "preVoteReply",
572	            "term": msg["term"],
573	            "round": msg["round"],
574	            "prospectiveTerm": msg["prospectiveTerm"],
575	            "result": "delivered",
576	            "detail": detail,
577	        })
578	        if msg["term"] > st.term:
579	            self._become_follower(dst, msg["term"], "higherTermMessage")
580	        elif won:
581	            # Still online (delivery ensured it), eligible, same round and
582	            # unchanged term: raise the term to the prospective term and open
583	            # the real election.
584	            self._promote_from_pre_vote(dst)

586	    def _handle_heartbeat(self, msg: dict) -> None:
587	        src, dst = msg["src"], msg["dst"]
588	        st = self.state[dst]
589	        accepted = msg["term"] >= st.term
590	        self._record({
591	            "type": "messageResult",
592	            "node": dst,
593	            "peer": src,
594	            "message": "heartbeat",
595	            "term": msg["term"],
596	            "result": "delivered",
597	            "detail": "accepted" if accepted else "staleTerm",
598	        })
599	        if not accepted:
600	            return
601	        if msg["term"] > st.term or st.role != ROLE_FOLLOWER:
602	            self._become_follower(dst, msg["term"], "heartbeat")
603	        else:
604	            self._reset_timeout(dst)
605	        st.known_leader = src
606	        # A current-term heartbeat is leader contact: it suppresses pre-vote
607	        # grants until the local election deadline next elapses (and stepping
608	        # down above canceled any active pre-vote round).
609	        st.leader_contact = self.now
610	        # Heartbeats carry leaderCommit even when no entry is in flight.
611	        if msg.get("leaderCommit", 0) > st.commit_index:
612	            st.commit_index = min(msg["leaderCommit"], st.last_log_index())
613	        self._advance_apply(dst)

615	    def _handle_append_entries(self, msg: dict) -> None:
616	        src, dst = msg["src"], msg["dst"]
617	        st = self.state[dst]
618	        if msg["term"] < st.term:
619	            self._record({
620	                "type": "messageResult",
621	                "node": dst,
622	                "peer": src,
623	                "message": "appendEntries",
624	                "term": msg["term"],
625	                "result": "delivered",
626	                "detail": "staleTerm",
627	            })
628	            self.network.send(
629	                dst,
630	                src,
631	                {"kind": "appendReply", "term": st.term, "success": False, "matchIndex": 0},
632	            )
633	            return
634	
635	        if msg["term"] > st.term or st.role != ROLE_FOLLOWER:
636	            self._become_follower(dst, msg["term"], "appendEntries")
637	        else:
638	            self._reset_timeout(dst)
639	        st.known_leader = src
640	        # A current-term appendEntries (even one that reports a prefix
641	        # conflict below) proves leader contact and suppresses pre-vote grants
642	        # until the next election deadline.
643	        st.leader_contact = self.now
644	
645	        prev_index = msg["prevLogIndex"]
646	        prefix_ok = (
647	            prev_index >= st.snapshot_index
648	            and prev_index <= st.last_log_index()
649	            and st.term_at(prev_index) == msg["prevLogTerm"]
650	        )
651	        if not prefix_ok:
652	            self._record({
653	                "type": "messageResult",
654	                "node": dst,
655	                "peer": src,
656	                "message": "appendEntries",
657	                "term": msg["term"],
658	                "result": "delivered",
659	                "detail": "conflict",
660	                "prevLogIndex": prev_index,
661	            })
662	            self.network.send(
663	                dst,
664	                src,
665	                {"kind": "appendReply", "term": st.term, "success": False, "matchIndex": 0},
666	            )
667	            return
668	
669	        # Latest configuration decides voting/campaigning as soon as an entry
670	        # is appended, so start or stop the election timer when the batch
671	        # changes this node's membership. Compute eligibility before any
672	        # truncation or append.
673	        eligible_before = self._can_vote(dst)
674	
675	        # Truncate the suffix at the first position whose term differs.
676	        conflict_index = 0
677	        for offset, entry in enumerate(msg["entries"]):
678	            index = prev_index + 1 + offset
679	            if st.has_entry(index) and st.log[index - 1 - st.snapshot_index]["term"] != entry["term"]:
680	                conflict_index = index
681	                del st.log[index - 1 - st.snapshot_index:]
682	                break
683	
684	        # Append whatever is not already present with a matching term.
685	        appended = 0
686	        for offset, entry in enumerate(msg["entries"]):
687	            index = prev_index + 1 + offset
688	            if index > st.last_log_index():
689	                if entry.get("kind") == KIND_CONFIG:
690	                    stored = {
691	                        "index": index,
692	                        "term": entry["term"],
693	                        "kind": KIND_CONFIG,
694	                        "id": entry["id"],
695	                        "entryType": entry["entryType"],
696	                        "config": entry["config"],
697	                        "action": entry["action"],
698	                        "member": entry["member"],
699	                    }
700	                else:
701	                    stored = self._command_entry(
702	                        index, entry["term"], entry["id"], entry["command"]
703	                    )
704	                st.log.append(stored)
705	                appended += 1
706	
707	        self._reconcile_election_timer(dst, eligible_before)
708	
709	        config_entries = [
710	            {
711	                "index": entry["index"],
712	                "id": entry["id"],
713	                "entryType": entry["entryType"],
714	            }
715	            for entry in msg["entries"]
716	            if entry.get("kind") == KIND_CONFIG
717	        ]
718	        result_entry = {
719	            "type": "messageResult",
720	            "node": dst,
721	            "peer": src,
722	            "message": "appendEntries",
723	            "term": msg["term"],
724	            "result": "delivered",
725	            "detail": "conflict" if conflict_index else "accepted",
726	            "prevLogIndex": prev_index,
727	            "appended": appended,
728	            "lastLogIndex": st.last_log_index(),
729	        }
730	        if config_entries:
731	            # Configuration replication is reported separately from ordinary
732	            # client-command replication.
733	            result_entry["configEntries"] = config_entries
734	        self._record(result_entry)
735	
736	        if msg["leaderCommit"] > st.commit_index:
737	            st.commit_index = min(msg["leaderCommit"], st.last_log_index())
738	        self._advance_apply(dst)
739	
740	        self.network.send(
741	            dst,
742	            src,
743	            {
744	                "kind": "appendReply",
745	                "term": st.term,
746	                "success": True,
747	                "matchIndex": st.last_log_index(),
748	            },
749	        )

751	    def _handle_install_snapshot(self, msg: dict) -> None:
752	        src, dst = msg["src"], msg["dst"]
753	        st = self.state[dst]
754	        included_index = msg["lastIncludedIndex"]
755	        included_term = msg["lastIncludedTerm"]
756	        if msg["term"] < st.term:
757	            self._record({
758	                "type": "messageResult",
759	                "node": dst,
760	                "peer": src,
761	                "message": "installSnapshot",
762	                "term": msg["term"],
763	                "result": "delivered",
764	                "detail": "staleTerm",
765	                "lastIncludedIndex": included_index,
766	            })
767	            self.network.send(
768	                dst,
769	                src,
770	                {
771	                    "kind": "installSnapshotReply",
772	                    "term": st.term,
773	                    "result": "staleTerm",
774	                    "lastIncludedIndex": included_index,
775	                    "snapshotIndex": st.snapshot_index,
776	                    "lastLogIndex": st.last_log_index(),
777	                },
778	            )
779	            return
780	
781	        if msg["term"] > st.term or st.role != ROLE_FOLLOWER:
782	            self._become_follower(dst, msg["term"], "installSnapshot")
783	        else:
784	            self._reset_timeout(dst)
785	        st.known_leader = src
786	        # A current-term installSnapshot is leader contact regardless of
787	        # whether the snapshot is installed or ignored as redundant.
788	        st.leader_contact = self.now
789	
790	        if included_index <= st.snapshot_index:
791	            # An equal-or-newer snapshot already covers this position.
792	            self._record({
793	                "type": "messageResult",
794	                "node": dst,
795	                "peer": src,
796	                "message": "installSnapshot",
797	                "term": msg["term"],
798	                "result": "delivered",
799	                "detail": "ignored",
800	                "lastIncludedIndex": included_index,
801	            })
802	            self.network.send(
803	                dst,
804	                src,
805	                {
806	                    "kind": "installSnapshotReply",
807	                    "term": st.term,
808	                    "result": "ignored",
809	                    "lastIncludedIndex": included_index,
810	                    "snapshotIndex": st.snapshot_index,
811	                    "lastLogIndex": st.last_log_index(),
812	                },
813	            )
814	            return
815	
816	        # Accept the snapshot. A suffix entry at the snapshot boundary with a
817	        # matching term is still valid and is kept; any other suffix is
818	        # discarded, including a same-position entry from a different term.
819	        eligible_before = self._can_vote(dst)
820	        keep = (
821	            st.has_entry(included_index)
822	            and st.term_at(included_index) == included_term
823	        )
824	        snapshot_entries = [dict(entry) for entry in msg["entries"]]
825	        # Recover the configuration in force at the snapshot position from
826	        # the applied entries bundled into the snapshot.
827	        snap_config = None
828	        for bundled in snapshot_entries:
829	            if bundled.get("kind") == KIND_CONFIG:
830	                snap_config = bundled["config"]
831	        if keep:
832	            # The entry at included_index joins the snapshot; retain only the
833	            # entries strictly following it, together with whatever the
834	            # follower had already applied beyond the snapshot point (such
835	            # entries were committed and must not be applied twice).
836	            retained_applied = [
837	                dict(entry) for entry in st.applied if entry["index"] > included_index
838	            ]
839	            st.log = st.log[included_index - st.snapshot_index:]
840	            st.applied = snapshot_entries + retained_applied
841	        else:
842	            st.log = []
843	            # Snapshot contents arrive as already-applied state: restore them
844	            # silently, so no applied events are emitted for them.
845	            st.applied = snapshot_entries
846	        st.snapshot_index = included_index
847	        st.snapshot_term = included_term
848	        st.snapshot_config = snap_config
849	        if st.commit_index < included_index:
850	            st.commit_index = included_index
851	        st.last_applied = len(st.applied)
852	
853	        self._record({
854	            "type": "messageResult",
855	            "node": dst,
856	            "peer": src,
857	            "message": "installSnapshot",
858	            "term": msg["term"],
859	            "result": "delivered",
860	            "detail": "installed",
861	            "lastIncludedIndex": included_index,
862	            "lastIncludedTerm": included_term,
863	        })
864	        self._record({
865	            "type": "snapshotInstalled",
866	            "node": dst,
867	            "peer": src,
868	            "lastIncludedIndex": included_index,
869	            "lastIncludedTerm": included_term,
870	        })
871	        # Configuration and membership arrive as already-restored state, just
872	        # like commands: no configurationApplied events are emitted for them.
873	        self._restore_membership_from_snapshot(dst, snapshot_entries, snap_config, eligible_before)
874	        # Apply whatever suffix entries are now committed beyond the snapshot.
875	        self._advance_apply(dst)
876	        self.network.send(
877	            dst,
878	            src,
879	            {
880	                "kind": "installSnapshotReply",
881	                "term": st.term,
882	                "result": "installed",
883	                "lastIncludedIndex": included_index,
884	                "snapshotIndex": st.snapshot_index,
885	                "lastLogIndex": st.last_log_index(),
886	            },
887	        )

921	    def _handle_snapshot_reply(self, msg: dict) -> None:
922	        src, dst = msg["src"], msg["dst"]
923	        st = self.state[dst]
924	        if msg["term"] > st.term:
925	            self._record({
926	                "type": "messageResult",
927	                "node": dst,
928	                "peer": src,
929	                "message": "installSnapshotReply",
930	                "term": msg["term"],
931	                "result": "delivered",
932	                "detail": "higherTerm",
933	            })
934	            self._become_follower(dst, msg["term"], "higherTermMessage")
935	            return
936	        if st.role != ROLE_LEADER or msg["term"] != st.term:
937	            self._record({
938	                "type": "messageResult",
939	                "node": dst,
940	                "peer": src,
941	                "message": "installSnapshotReply",
942	                "term": msg["term"],
943	                "result": "delivered",
944	                "detail": "ignored",
945	            })
946	            return
947	
948	        result = msg["result"]
949	        if result == "installed":
950	            included = msg["lastIncludedIndex"]
951	            if included > st.match_index[src]:
952	                st.match_index[src] = included
953	            if included + 1 > st.next_index[src]:
954	                st.next_index[src] = included + 1
955	            self._record({
956	                "type": "messageResult",
957	                "node": dst,
958	                "peer": src,
959	                "message": "installSnapshotReply",
960	                "term": msg["term"],
961	                "result": "delivered",
962	                "detail": "installed",
963	                "matchIndex": st.match_index[src],
964	            })
965	            # Resume log replication from the entry right after the snapshot.
966	            self._replicate_to(dst, src)
967	            self._progress_catchup(dst)
968	            return
969	
970	        if result == "staleTerm":
971	            # Same-term refusal (the peer led in this term, for example): no
972	            # progress change; the next heartbeat retries reconciliation.
973	            self._record({
974	                "type": "messageResult",
975	                "node": dst,
976	                "peer": src,
977	                "message": "installSnapshotReply",
978	                "term": msg["term"],
979	                "result": "delivered",
980	                "detail": "staleTerm",
981	            })
982	            return
983	
984	        # The follower already holds an equal-or-newer snapshot: advance its
985	        # progress conservatively and let appendEntries reconcile the suffix.
986	        peer_snapshot = min(msg["snapshotIndex"], st.last_log_index())
987	        if peer_snapshot > st.match_index[src]:
988	            st.match_index[src] = peer_snapshot
989	        if peer_snapshot + 1 > st.next_index[src]:
990	            st.next_index[src] = peer_snapshot + 1
991	        self._record({
992	            "type": "messageResult",
993	            "node": dst,
994	            "peer": src,
995	            "message": "installSnapshotReply",
996	            "term": msg["term"],
997	            "result": "delivered",
998	            "detail": "ignored",
999	            "matchIndex": st.match_index[src],
1000	        })
1001	        self._replicate_to(dst, src)

1003	    def _handle_append_reply(self, msg: dict) -> None:
1004	        src, dst = msg["src"], msg["dst"]
1005	        st = self.state[dst]
1006	        if msg["term"] > st.term:
1007	            self._record({
1008	                "type": "messageResult",
1009	                "node": dst,
1010	                "peer": src,
1011	                "message": "appendReply",
1012	                "term": msg["term"],
1013	                "result": "delivered",
1014	                "detail": "higherTerm",
1015	            })
1016	            self._become_follower(dst, msg["term"], "higherTermMessage")
1017	            return
1018	        if st.role != ROLE_LEADER or msg["term"] != st.term:
1019	            self._record({
1020	                "type": "messageResult",
1021	                "node": dst,
1022	                "peer": src,
1023	                "message": "appendReply",
1024	                "term": msg["term"],
1025	                "result": "delivered",
1026	                "detail": "ignored",
1027	            })
1028	            return
1029	
1030	        if msg["success"]:
1031	            # A follower with a longer divergent suffix can acknowledge a
1032	            # batch whose shared positions already match; the leader must not
1033	            # treat positions beyond its own log end as replicated.
1034	            match = min(msg["matchIndex"], st.last_log_index())
1035	            advanced = match > st.match_index[src]
1036	            if advanced:
1037	                st.match_index[src] = match
1038	                if match + 1 > st.next_index[src]:
1039	                    st.next_index[src] = match + 1
1040	            self._record({
1041	                "type": "messageResult",
1042	                "node": dst,
1043	                "peer": src,
1044	                "message": "appendReply",
1045	                "term": msg["term"],
1046	                "result": "delivered",
1047	                "detail": "matched",
1048	                "matchIndex": st.match_index[src],
1049	            })
1050	            if advanced:
1051	                self._advance_leader_commit(dst)
1052	            self._progress_catchup(dst)
1053	            return
1054	
1055	        # Deterministic backoff: retry one log position earlier.
1056	        if st.next_index[src] > 1:
1057	            st.next_index[src] -= 1
1058	        self._record({
1059	            "type": "messageResult",
1060	            "node": dst,
1061	            "peer": src,
1062	            "message": "appendReply",
1063	            "term": msg["term"],
1064	            "result": "delivered",
1065	            "detail": "conflict",
1066	            "nextIndex": st.next_index[src],
1067	        })
1068	        self._replicate_to(dst, src)

1152	    def _check_read_completion(self, query_id: str) -> None:
1153	        """Complete a pending read once a strict majority of every quorum
1154	        group of the recorded configuration (stable: the voter set; joint:
1155	        both the old and the new sets; learners never count) has acknowledged
1156	        the probe in the same term."""

1158	        if read is None:
1159	            return
1160	        name = read["node"]
1161	        st = self.state[name]
1162	        if st.role != ROLE_LEADER or st.term != read["term"]:
1163	            return
1164	        if not self._has_vote_majorities(name, read["acks"], read["config"]):
1165	            return
1166	        read_index = read["readIndex"]
1167	        state = [
1168	            self._read_state_entry(entry)
1169	            for entry in st.applied[:read_index]
1170	            if entry.get("kind") != KIND_CONFIG
1171	        ]

1174	            "outcome": "completed",
1175	            "term": read["term"],
1176	            "readIndex": read_index,
1177	            "state": state,
1178	        }
1179	        self._record({
1180	            "type": "readResult",
1181	            "node": name,
1182	            "id": query_id,
1183	            "result": "completed",
1184	            "term": read["term"],
1185	            "readIndex": read_index,

1333	    def _change_in_progress(self, st: _Node, leader: str) -> bool:
1334	        pending = self.pending_catchup
1335	        if pending is not None and pending["leader"] == leader and st.role == ROLE_LEADER:
1336	            return True
1337	        # The change runs until its stable entry commits: a committed joint
1338	        # config, or any not-yet-committed config entry (the appended stable

1341	            return True

1343	            entry.get("kind") == KIND_CONFIG and entry["index"] > st.commit_index
1344	            for entry in st.log

1366	    def _on_membership_change(self, change: dict) -> None:
1367	        node = change["node"]
1368	        change_id = change["id"]
1369	        action = change["action"]
1370	        member = change["member"]
1371	        st = self.state[node]
1372	        # Rejection precedence: receiver down -> not the leader -> another
1373	        # change already running -> member state not applicable -> removing
1374	        # would leave fewer than three voters.
1375	        if not st.online:
1376	            self._record_membership_rejected(change, "nodeDown")
1377	            return
1378	        if st.role != ROLE_LEADER:
1379	            self._record_membership_rejected(change, "notLeader")
1380	            return
1381	        if self._change_in_progress(st, node):
1382	            self._record_membership_rejected(change, "changeInProgress")
1383	            return
1384	        _, voters = self._config_groups(st.committed_config(self.initial_config))
1385	        voters = frozenset(voters)
1386	        if action == "add":
1387	            if member in voters:
1388	                self._record_membership_rejected(change, "alreadyMember")
1389	                return
1390	            new_voters = voters | {member}
1391	        else:
1392	            if member not in voters:

1394	                return

1396	        if len(new_voters) < 3:
1397	            self._record_membership_rejected(change, "minimumClusterSize")
1398	            return

1401	            "node": node,

1465	    def _progress_catchup(self, name: str) -> None:
1466	        """Append the joint entry once the added learner has caught the
1467	        leader's log end (via log replication or an installed snapshot)."""
1468	        pending = self.pending_catchup
1469	        if pending is None:
1470	            return
1471	        st = self.state[name]
1472	        if st.role != ROLE_LEADER or pending["leader"] != name:
1473	            return
1474	        member = pending["member"]
1475	        latest = st.latest_config(self.initial_config)
1476	        if latest.get("type") == CONFIG_JOINT:
1477	            # Another change already moved the cluster into a joint phase.
1478	            return
1479	        _, voters = self._config_groups(st.committed_config(self.initial_config))
1480	        voters = frozenset(voters)
1481	        if (pending["action"] == "add") == (member in voters):
1482	            # The requested relationship no longer matches committed state.
1483	            return
1484	        if st.match_index.get(member, 0) < st.last_log_index():

1487	        self._append_joint_entry(name, pending["id"], pending["action"], member, voters)
